summary: Master cinematic drone flight, HDR photography, and AI-enhanced editing for real estate. Professional 5-day course for high-end property marketing.
lede: Drone photography for real estate marketing combines aerial flight planning and visual production to document properties. Designed for professionals with basic flight experience, this intermediate course develops skills in site assessment, camera exposure and HDR capture, and creating edited property imagery and video. The syllabus also covers automated waypoint missions, indoor tours, photogrammetry, and planning aerial marketing services.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is designed for professionals who have basic flight experience and wish to specialize in high-end property marketing and commercial site documentation.
modules: Advanced Camera Settings and HDR Bracketing
Cinematic Flight Maneuvers and Motion Control
Indoor FPV and Virtual Property Tours
Building a Scalable Aerial Marketing Strategy
prerequisites: Participants should have basic drone flight experience (minimum 10 hours) and familiarity with digital photography concepts. Access to a UAS with a 4K camera and a laptop with Adobe® Creative Cloud® is recommended for the practical exercises.
